events.comment: Shared combat rules. Runs before the Samurai events so they can react on the same frame.

Fire Knight death hold: his HP reached 0 on his last life without a posture break (Combat_Shared just set JustDied). Instead of dying at once, he drops into the kneel, posture-broken at 0.01 HP with the deathblow orb, so the fight ends on a deathblow. JustDied and JustLostLife are both cleared.

Fire Knight death hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he finishes dying on his own. HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take the last life next frame, and clearing JustRecovered stops his sheet from standing him up.

Fire Knight life hold: his HP reached 0 with a life to spare (phase 1). Combat_Shared already took the life (JustLostLife). Instead he gets it back and kneels at 0.01 HP, posture-broken, with the deathblow orb; the deathblow then starts the Rekindle.

Fire Knight life hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he loses the life anyway. HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take it next frame, and his sheet's Rekindle then starts phase 2. LifeHold 2 keeps the hold above from catching it again.
Fire Knight life hold: the life is gone (to the deathblow or the timeout), so the hold is over.
Scene start: the Fire Knight's own music goes here, like the other fights. TODO: add a track to assets/Music and a PlayMusic action.
Scene start: hide the red Invisible_Wall colliders. The Samurai sheet does this in his scenes, but this scene does not include it.
Arena: Moonlit Ruins ambience (moon glow, drifting clouds and fog, fireflies). Its objects are in the "Arena Moonlit Ruins" folder, on the Background layer behind the floor.

events.comment: The Fire Knight, from the Fire_Knight_Boss sheet.

Fire Knight death hold: plain hits cannot land while he kneels, so only the deathblow (which ignores Invulnerable) or the timeout ends him. His sheet's kneel event clears Invulnerable, so this runs after it.
Fire Knight life hold: the same, plain hits cannot land while he kneels at 0 HP, or one would take the life without a deathblow.
Fire Knight death hold: his sheet starts FK_death from frame 0, but he is already kneeling, which is its frame 4. Carry on from there, so he does not pop up and fall again.
